pose_constraints.posture: Strictly vertical 'Pillar' stance; head held alert and forward.
pose_constraints.orientation: Direct head-on, front-facing view. The snout is the closest point to the camera.
pose_constraints.grounding: Standing on flat, sun-bleached coastal sand with scattered shell fragments.
pose_constraints.body_logic: The entire back and spike-covered tail are hidden directly behind the chest and head. Silhouette width must stay within 280px.
pose_constraints.framing_note: The long shoulder spines (parascapular spines) should extend symmetrically to the left and right, framing the chest without exceeding the horizontal safe zone.

character_details.expression: Friendly, inquisitive smirk; large, soulful eyes looking directly forward.
character_details.texture: Tactile, leathery skin with soft tan and cream 'counter-shading' patterns.

environmental_details.ground: Pale tan sand and silt with subtle ripple marks from a retreating tide.
flora: Cycads and small tree ferns positioned far in the background to maintain scale
environmental_details.background: A distant glimpse of a calm, turquoise lagoon under a bright Jurassic sun.
environmental_details.sky: Vibrant, cloudless sky to provide high-contrast rim lighting on the spikes.
